OPENAI_API.description: OpenAI API key used to pick the best clips (or set LLM_PROVIDER=heuristic to try without one).

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Optional: OpenAI-compatible gateway URL, e.g. https://ai.paas.id. Leave empty for api.openai.com.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional: Anthropic key to use Claude directly (provider: anthropic).

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Optional: Google AI Studio key to use Gemini directly (provider: gemini).

LLM_MODEL.description: Optional: model name to use (as listed by your provider/gateway). Empty = gpt-4o-mini.
